articles.title: Live Updates: Trump vows to hit Iran hard after U.S., Tehran exchange strikes for the first time in weeks - CBS News
articles.description: President Trump says the U.S. will hit Iran hard after it targeted American bases, which Tehran said was in retaliation for U.S. attacks in the Strait of Hormuz.
